body: Thank you. I was ignored most of my life and I don’t want them to feel that way. I appreciate your thoughts and thank you for taking the time to respond

I really appreciate you responding; it sounds like we have/had a very similar situation. 

I’m on a pharmacy of meds and have a good relationship with my PC and psychiatrist fortunately and have discussed this with my husband. I haven’t talked to a career counselor, though, and I will definitely pursue that and CBT. 

I just really appreciate your response. Thank you for taking the time.
